big_story.headline: Dalal Street Defies Global Tech Rout
big_story.subhead: INDIAN BENCHMARKS RECORD BIGGEST WEEKLY GAINS IN SIX YEARS AS NIFTY RECLAIMS 25,000
paragraphs: Indian equities staged a massive rally as the Nifty 50 jumped 2.01% to 25,030.35, while the Sensex crossed 81,000. The domestic market shrugged off a widespread global technology selloff to deliver its biggest weekly gains in six years. Heavyweight banking and pharmaceutical stocks led the buying surge, insulating domestic sentiment from international headwinds.

The rally unfolded against a turbulent global backdrop where tumbling technology stocks rattled Western and Asian markets. However, strong domestic participation and resilient earnings helped Indian indices decouple from the international tech rout. Investors rotated capital into key sectors, providing fresh momentum to benchmark indices.

Market observers note that while the Nifty may find fresh fuel, capital flows continue to seek stability in domestic fundamentals. Key factors ahead include monitoring policy consistency and foreign institutional interest. Tracing how domestic markets absorb elevated global crude oil prices will remain critical for sustaining this momentum.
big_story.pullbox: Dalal Street's resilience highlights a decoupling narrative, where strong domestic fundamentals buffer Indian equities against international tech turbulence.

explains.title: What is Market Decoupling?
paragraphs: Market decoupling refers to a scenario where a domestic stock market moves independently from global equity trends or foreign indices. It occurs when internal economic drivers and domestic investor flows outweigh international headwinds.

In practice, strong domestic participation and robust corporate earnings allow local benchmarks to rally even during global selloffs. This independence shields national markets from external shocks occurring in foreign financial hubs.

Space technology startup Cosmoserve, founded by a former ISRO scientist, raised $6 million in seed funding to advance satellite servicing and space debris removal technology. The Hyderabad-based startup has established Base 1 to commercialize its space cleanup solutions by 2028.

The capital will fund research and development into autonomous satellite servicing craft designed to clear hazardous orbital waste. As satellite constellations expand rapidly, Cosmoserve's specialized orbital servicing aims to capture a vital emerging niche in commercial space infrastructure.

story_1.headline: DGFT Invites Quotas for 24,500 UK Car Imports
paragraphs: India's Directorate General of Foreign Trade has officially invited applications for importing 24,500 passenger vehicles under the India-UK trade agreement. The application process allows domestic importers to secure designated tariff quotas for vehicles manufactured in the United Kingdom.
The step operationalises key commercial clauses of the trade deal, opening structured access for British automotive manufacturers into India's expanding automobile market.

story_2.headline: Cosmoserve Secures $6 Million to Clear Space Debris
paragraphs: Space technology startup Cosmoserve has raised $6 million in a seed funding round to advance satellite servicing and space debris removal technologies. Founded by a former ISRO scientist, the startup established its Base 1 facility in Hyderabad and aims for full commercialisation by 2028.
The capital injection will fuel early engineering and testing of orbital cleanup systems, targeting the growing problem of space debris as commercial satellite launches accelerate worldwide.

story_3.headline: NSE to Revise Closing Auction and F&O Hours
paragraphs: The National Stock Exchange has announced plans to revise its closing auction session and derivative trading hours starting December 7. The structural modification aims to optimize execution windows and market liquidity for participating traders.

geopolitics.headline: US Midterm Defeat Prompts Call to End Tariff Row
paragraphs: Following Donald Trump's US midterm election defeat, former official John Bolton urged Democrats to repeal Trump's tariffs. Bolton warned that critical US-India security ties have been lost in the escalating tariff row, urging the incoming Democrat-held Congress to restore economic alignment.

The midterm results bring a potential shift to bilateral trade and strategic policy between Washington and New Delhi. Indian policymakers and market observers are watching closely to see if Congress moves to ease tariffs and repair trade relations.

big_story.headline: Samvat 2082 Scorecard: Midcaps Outshine Falling Sensex and Nifty
big_story.text: As Samvat 2082 came to a close, Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty recorded a drop of nearly 4%. However, midcap and smallcap indices bucked the trend by outperforming the broader market. This divergence underscores strong retail investor interest in broader market equities despite foreign fund outflows from front-line stocks.

big_story.headline: V-Marc India Q1 FY27 Revenue Surges 102.4% to ₹555.5 Crore
big_story.text: Electrical equipment maker V-Marc India Ltd reported a massive 102.4% year-on-year surge in revenue to ₹555.5 crore for the first quarter of FY27. The robust top-line growth highlights expanding power distribution and infrastructure demand across India, driving strong order execution for domestic manufacturers.

venture_vault.headline: Ottonomy Raises ₹40.6 Crore to Scale Autonomous Hospital Robots
venture_vault.text: Autonomous robotics startup Ottonomy secured ₹40.6 crore in fresh funding to expand its global operations. The company builds specialized robots capable of carrying blood samples and medical supplies inside hospitals. This capital injection will help scale deep-tech hardware manufacturing from India for international healthcare markets.

venture_vault.headline: OneStack Secures ₹12.5 Crore to Integrate Cooperative Banks with UPI
venture_vault.text: Fintech startup OneStack raised ₹12.5 crore from Shepherd's Hill to digitize regional financial institutions. Founded to bridge India's digital divide, OneStack enables cooperative banks to integrate with the Unified Payments Interface ecosystem, expanding modern digital banking services across semi-urban and rural communities.

geopolitics.headline: India Invites Bids for 24,500 UK Car Imports Under Trade Pact
geopolitics.text: India's Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has officially opened applications for importing 24,500 UK vehicles under the India-UK trade agreement. The move marks a concrete step forward in bilateral trade relations, easing market access for British automakers while expanding choices for Indian premium automobile consumers.

geopolitics.headline: India and EU Wrap Talks on Multi-Billion Euro Innovation Programme
geopolitics.text: India and the European Union concluded negotiations on a multi-billion Euro joint research and innovation initiative. The landmark pact aims to boost collaborative technology development, clean energy research, and scientific exchanges between European institutions and Indian universities, deepening strategic diplomatic ties.
